mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 2.1 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives corporate revenue expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 50% of instances when HOUST > 2.1M, or the average return in high-permit periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 108.0 index points signals weakening manufacturing activity and broadening economic slowdown, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 108.0, or the average return in low-industrial periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both personal consumption expenditures and residential investment signals a broad-based demand surge that increases corporate earnings visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when both PAYEMS and HOUST are rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate signals a Fed commitment to inflation control, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS are rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payrolls above 200k in a single month, combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals strong labor market momentum that accelerates wage growth and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 200 and UNRATE < 5.0%, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures above 357,000 million dollars signals strong consumer demand that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 357000, or the average return in high-demand periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
